text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, as we stroll through the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I sense trouble and it's big! In other words, the perfect opportunity for a class representative to step in!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's just a raffle! If that's trouble, it's hardly a problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I actually happen to have a raffle ticket with me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My classmate gave it to me. She said I'd probably like it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: She also said it was easy to imagine me wrangling the raffle spinner!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Just another example of my daily efforts as class representative being appreciated!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, I'm going to try my luck at the raffle! I've only got one shot at this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Every prize will be mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, at least one grand prize. I will not fail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As you can see, I am very well-behaved! The god of raffles will not abandon me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Today is the day! O spirit whose love is endless for class representatives! Look favorably upon this exemplary class representative before y—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood! Here I go! Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I quell Sakura Bakushin O's desire to run a bit too wild, we grasp the lever together and turn the tumbler.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoooaa! We got the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So what's next?! Why aren't there more balls where that came from?!
choice_data_list: One grand prize is more than enough!
One grand prize is more than enough!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now that you mention it, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Naturally, a class representative like myself would excel at winning at raffles too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That I am! Turns out my luck is in the upper ranks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm not surprised that even raffle prizes are drawn to someone with as much charisma as myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is it my imagination, or… doesn't this ball look quite cute?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Is it okay if I keep it in my room as a pet?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haha! I'm joking! My good sense of humor is always ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And now I shall give this coupon to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I still have a lot more things to do as class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There is no time to spare getting relaxed, refreshed, or toasty!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Should there come a time in society where class representatives are made obsolete by their exceedingly exemplary status, then I'll visit the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I believe you will know when that time has come! Please, let me task you with this duty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I'm not sure what she means, but I'll hold onto the coupon for her.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is great! And it's deluxe too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It says deluxe, but this goes beyond first class! It's the kind of thing you'd see at a fine dining spot! This is a hamburger steak practically made for class representatives!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: One class representative plus one hamburger steak perfectly suited for class representatives. There's only one outcome here…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: TO EAT!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoops. I'll save you a bite, of course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sharing is caring. That's the slogan our class has chosen for this month!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: One class representative plus one hamburger steak perfectly suited for class representatives plus the trainer who's always looking out for me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With a lineup like this, there's no doubt this deluxe hamburger steak will be dined upon in an exemplary fashion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Sakura Bakushin O's kindness, I'm able to enjoy the taste of luxury with her.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wow, a bushel! That has a good ring to it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The bigger things are, the better!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However, I'm a little stumped as to how I'll be able to finish all of this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! So that's what I'm supposed to do with them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Cooking is all about making the ingredients tastier, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That means these carrots have been waiting for me to make them into a delicious sensation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Just leave it to me! I, Sakura Bakushin O, will put my title as class representative at stake!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I will have you all transform into the tastiest little treats!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I'm a bit uneasy, so I decide to help her cook when the time comes.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Just one carrot, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh?! What if there's a big secret hiding inside?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It may look like just one carrot… but perhaps it's symbolic?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm! On closer inspection, the shape seems to have some kind of meaning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: For this prize to be bestowed onto a class representative, there's no way it can be an ordinary carrot!
choice_data_list: …Did you watch that detective show yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: How did you know?! Looks like there was a detective right under my nose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Who can reveal the secrets of this carrot, Detective Class Representative or Detective Trainer? Let the game begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back, we fervently discuss the meaning of that single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ack! T-tissues?! And it's the consolation prize?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …N-no! There's simply no way I would become the recipient of a simple pack of tissues!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's a measly participation trophy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I got one of those in the town's trivia contest when I was a kid… And the marathon tournament… And every other tournament I stood in as class representative…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've received a lot of tissues! The ultimate participation award!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So these tissues must be a good thing… Right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's just that… back then, I wasn't super thrilled about the tissues either…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But I was the only one to get that award… Wait? Didn't the other kids get them too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait… huh? Hm? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O agonizes in her mind, at a loss for words…
